about_the_game:
Play as Dodo, a duckling raised alongside chickens by an old grandma on a quaint farm. One sunny day, a mysterious UFO appears and abducts all the chickens, leaving Dodo alone. Determined to rescue the chickens, Dodo follows the UFO through a portal, leading to a glitched dimension. 

A whole new way to explore! seamlessly switch from classic 2D to immersive 3D in a flash! at the touch of a button. Shift perspectives find new paths, hidden secrets and clever shortcuts are suddenly revealed, surprising you at every turn. 

Can one duck outwit aliens and save the flock? Flip perspectives and find out.

Take on challenges that blend the best of 2D platforming with inventive 3D shifts. Every shift in perspective transforms familiar gameplay into something fresh and exciting, testing both your reflexes and your wits delivering a fresh spin on classic gameplay.

Dodo: Raised by chickens and dreaming of belonging, Dodo’s world flips...literally!! When a UFO abducts its Chicken family. Chase through dimensional glitches, swap between 2D and 3D, and waddling its way through a heartwarming quest because even ducks deserve a happy ending.

 

Capie: The chillest capybara with the coolest caps. A laid-back merchant from a world of ancient tech and headwear obsession, Capie runs a quirky cap shop. When Dodo stumbles into a glitched dimension, Capie gifts the Dimensional Dual Switcher—a magical hat that lets Dodo switch between 2D and 3D.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Steam Deck
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 RDNA 2 CUs, 1.0-1.6GHz
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only Steam Deck is supported. No other Linux distos are supported

name: Dodo Duckie

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 (4096Mb) / Radeon RX 460 (4096Mb)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: Low Quality setting, 1080p, producing 30+ FPS, SSD Required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 (8192MB) / Radeon RX Vega 64 (8192 MB) / Intel Arc A750
  • Additional Notes: High Quality setting, 1080p, producing 60 FPS, SSD Required

short_description: Aliens abducted your chicken friends! Play as Dodo, a brave but slightly clueless duck on a mission to bring them home. The twist? Swap between 2D and 3D perspectives INSTANTLY to solve platforming puzzles and explore a cozy, charming world full of surprises.. like a capybara that sells caps.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
